title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Rakter Swad
desc: Police officer Arunava investigates false witchcraft rumours created by Dr Niyogi with disguised CBI officer Rajendra. Consequently, they rescue Roni and solve the case.

title: Geet Sangeet
desc: Abandoning his affluent background, a man chases his musical dreams. However, he finds himself employed as a driver and becomes smitten with his boss's daughter.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Mejo Bou
desc: Barun's father forces him to marry Sampa, a colleague from a middle-class background. After the marriage, Barun creates problems for his new wife and damages her reputation.

title: Anjali
desc: A devout father arranges his daughter's marriage with a renowned businessman. However, the daughter secretly resents the union as she is madly in love with her boyfriend.
